lines: Not nine-self, not word-heap, not Bhairava —
not three-headed god, not power-triad's nature.
sanskrit_cite: tattvato na navātmāsau śabdarāśir na bhairavaḥ | na cāsau triśirā devo na ca śaktitrayātmakaḥ

lines: Not nāda-drop, not moon's checks, not wheel-joined —
not power-formed.
sanskrit_cite: nādabindumayo vāpi na candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | na cakrakramasambhinno na ca śaktisvarūpakaḥ

lines: For unawakened minds these are strong terrors;
like mother's sweet — all for the sake of going on.
sanskrit_cite: aprabuddhamatīnāṃ hi etā balavibhīṣikāḥ | mātṛmodakavat sarvaṃ pravṛttyarthaṃ udāhṛtam

lines: Free of direction, time and counting, place-point
unspecified: untellable, ultimately unpointable.
sanskrit_cite: dikkālakalanonmuktā deśoddeśāviśeṣinī | vyapadeṣṭum aśakyāsāv akathyā paramārthataḥ

lines: Joy within — inner self-taste, unhoused in fancy:
that full-formed state — Bhairavī of Bhairava's self.
sanskrit_cite: antaḥsvānubhavānandā vikalponmuktagocarā | yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavī bhairavātmanaḥ

lines: That body must be known in truth — stainless,
world-filling: who worships, which pleased, in such reality?
sanskrit_cite: tad vapus tattvato jñeyaṃ vimalaṃ viśvapūraṇam | evaṃvidhe pare tattve kaḥ pūjyaḥ kaś ca tṛpyati

lines: Whatever state of Bhairava's is sung like this —
she is supreme: supreme goddess in supreme form.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃvidhā bhairavasya yāvasthā parigīyate | sā parā pararūpeṇa parā devī prakīrtitā

lines: As power-and-powerful non-difference stands always,
hence: supreme power of the supreme self.
sanskrit_cite: śaktiśaktimator yadvad abhedaḥ sarvadā sthitaḥ | atas taddharmadharmitvāt parā śaktiḥ parātmanaḥ

lines: No burning-power of fire is separate — conceived so;
only in knowing-being, in entering, the beginning starts.
sanskrit_cite: na vahner dāhikā śaktir vyatiriktā vibhāvyate | kevalaṃ jñānasattāyām prārambho 'yam praveśane

lines: Of one entered the power-state, contemplation
undivided: then he Śiva-formed — the mouth is called Śaivī.
sanskrit_cite: śaktyavasthāpraviṣṭasya nirvibhāgena bhāvanā | tadāsau śivarūpī syāt śaivī mukham ihocyate
